CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.me_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ select role from users where tg_id = me_tg() $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.me_tg()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$ select nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json->>'tg_id','')::bigint $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.me_venue()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ select venue_id from users where tg_id = me_tg() $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.users_default_manager()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  new.role := 'manager';
  return new;
end $function$
